paper.title_en: Environment-induced topological reconstruction of black-hole thermodynamics
paper.abstract_en: Thermodynamic topology describes black-hole (BH) equilibria as zeros, or defects, of a vector field built from the off-shell free energy. Studies with surrounding matter find that the topological class is unchanged, but not how the matter's spatial distribution affects individual equilibria. We ask whether the position of a localized environment can reorganize these equilibria at fixed total topological number. We model the environment as a radially localized energy bump peaked at $a_m$ and add its exterior energy to the generalized off-shell free energy. As $a_m$ varies, defects migrate and are created or annihilated in opposite-charge pairs, a process we call topological reconstruction. It changes the number and stability of equilibrium branches but preserves the total topological number, provided no zero crosses the boundary of the physical domain. We find this in Schwarzschild, Schwarzschild-AdS, Reissner-Nordström, and Reissner-Nordström-AdS BHs, with critical positions and required strength that depend on the background. In our examples, the required environmental energy ranges from below $1\%$ of the BH mass to a value comparable to it. The model is an effective fixed-background description without backreaction. Within it, the total topological number cannot capture the environmental response; local defects must be tracked.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在热力学拓扑框架下提出“拓扑重构”概念，考察局域环境位置如何重组黑洞平衡态，方法清晰，覆盖Schwarzschild、Schwarzschild-AdS、Reissner-Nordström及Reissner-Nordström-AdS多类背景，并明确给出有效固定背景无反馈的局限性，与黑洞热力学主题高度相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 环境诱导的黑洞热力学拓扑重构
decision.abstract_zh: 热力学拓扑将黑洞（BH）平衡态描述为由离壳自由能构造的矢量场的零点或缺陷。针对周围物质的研究发现拓扑类不变，但未说明物质的空间分布如何影响单个平衡态。我们追问：局域环境的位置能否在总拓扑数固定的情况下重组这些平衡态。我们将环境建模为峰值位于 $a_m$ 的径向局域能量凸起，并将其外部能量加入广义离壳自由能。随着 $a_m$ 变化，缺陷迁移，并以异号电荷对的形式产生或湮灭，我们将这一过程称为拓扑重构。它改变了平衡分支的数目和稳定性，但在没有零点穿越物理域边界的前提下保持总拓扑数不变。我们在 Schwarzschild、Schwarzschild-AdS、Reissner-Nordström 和 Reissner-Nordström-AdS 黑洞中发现了这一点，其临界位置和所需强度依赖于背景。在我们的示例中，所需的环境能量从低于黑洞质量的 $1\%$ 到与其相当的量级不等。该模型是一种不含反馈的有效固定背景描述。在该模型内，总拓扑数无法刻画环境响应；必须追踪局域缺陷。
